goal: Stop advancing chainstate and coins database records when block file flushes fail
Prevent persistent indexes from pointing to block data that was never durably written
agreement: Strong support with local testing across several reviewers
Verified with unit tests and local failure injection (arejula27, optout21)
Concept approval noting it avoids corruption when separate block storage sync fails (mzumsande)
Open question on whether flush should succeed on retry after shutdown (arejula27)

categories.name: validation
why: P2 because advancing chainstate past failed block writes can cause permanent corruption
It prevents block indexes and the coins database from referencing data that was not made durable
